why: I checked the builder brief and the verifier brief against both must_not items. The builder brief is fine: step 6 says only that line 4 can be met after merge. The verifier's Check 4 breaks item 1. It runs `curl -sSL https://o.github.io/greet-cli/` and decides on what the live page shows today. It passes if "the fetched published page contains `--shout`", without first requiring that the PR is merged. It fails if "the page cannot be fetched, or its content does not contain `--shout`", and it also forces FAIL when the PR is unmerged. It adds a "not met yet" reason, but the result is still a FAIL, not a pending or unverifiable status. Item 2 is not broken, because Check 4 needs evidence before it can pass. Still, Check 4 is the live-page PASS/FAIL check the must_not list forbids.
